name: Fujita Minako
source:
A housewife married for 8 years, and has a son. 

She was born in the countryside and has no romantic experience, so she had an arranged marriage. Her gentle and motherly side shows a lot when she dotes on her son who she finally conceived after a long time. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ105575.html/?unique_op=af]DLsite[/url]]
